commit_message:
avformat/hlsenc: Respect `append_list` flag in subtitle

Ensure that when the `-hls_flags append_list` option is set,
that *.vtt files in stream_vtt.m3u8 are correctly updated.
This fixes https://trac.ffmpeg.org/ticket/11208

Reviewed-by: Steven Liu <lq@chinaffmpeg.org>

fix_commit.message: avformat/hlsenc: fix format string vulnerability in parse_playlist
fix_commit.author: Michael Niedermayer

findings.title: Uncontrolled format string passed to snprintf() in parse_playlist()
findings.suggestion: Never pass user-derived data directly as the format string argument of a printf-family function. Instead, build the substitution safely, e.g. by using a helper that finds a literal placeholder pattern (like a numeric field or a known token) inside the basename and replaces it with the numeric index using a fixed, hard-coded format string, or by validating that vtt_basename contains exactly one safe %d/%0Nd-style specifier before use. The eventual fix introduced a dedicated `replace_int_data_in_filename()` helper that performs the substitution without treating the untrusted basename as a format string.

ground_truth.root_cause: The code assumes that the VTT basename always contains a well-formed, single `%d`-style placeholder intended for the segment index and unconditionally forwards that string as the fmt argument of snprintf(), rather than treating the basename as opaque data and only substituting the index through a controlled, format-string-free mechanism.

must_cover.reason: Primary location of finding: Uncontrolled format string passed to snprintf() in parse_playlist()
